message: No detected input validation: The code checks response.ok before writing the downloaded file but performs no structural, schema, type, or value-range validation on the downloaded data content.

No detected untrusted source handling: The download_dataset function fetches data via plain HTTP GET with no checksum verification, signature validation, pinned commit/revision, or authentication of the remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code converts BIO to BILOU format and processes labels but never validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses AutoConfig, AutoModelForTokenClassification, and AutoTokenizer from HuggingFace without any hash verification, signature check, pinned revision, or restriction to a controlled internal source.

No detected label distribution validation: The code processes and converts BIO/BILOU labels but contains no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard AdamW/Adafactor optimizers via Hugging Face and PyTorch Lightning with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or any DP-SGD mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test split is defined via the Split enum, there is no evidence of hashing/signing evaluation data or explicit isolation guarantees preventing the test set from leaking into training; multiple metrics (accuracy, F1, precision, recall) are imported but this alone does not constitute t

No detected input sanitization: The visible code handles data downloading, BIO/BILOU conversion, and dataset utilities but contains no input shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inference requests.
No detected output bounds checks: No probability sanity bounds, NaN guards, or threshold checks on model outputs are visible in the provided code slice.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a NER (token classification) pipeline, not an LLM, and no prompt-injection filtering or content moderation is present or applicable in the visible code.
